page.title: Skills
page.subtitle: Reusable instruction blocks. A skill is text — linked to an agent, it is appended to that agent's prompt in the order you set.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: A skill is a block of reviewer instructions you write once and attach to any agent. Create one, or import a markdown file or archive.

card.deleteConfirm: Delete skill "{name}"? It will be removed from every agent. This cannot be undone.

listItem.vettingTitle: Imported from outside — read it before enabling

config.title: Configuration
config.name: Name
config.descriptionPlaceholder: Use when the diff adds or changes tests…
config.descriptionHint: This is the skill's interface — it tells the agent WHEN the rules below apply. Write it as an instruction ("Use when…", "Check that…"), not as a summary.
config.bodyHint: The only text sent to the model. Editing the body is the entire skill — everything else is metadata. Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.
config.bodyPlaceholder:
# Rule
Describe what to flag and when…
config.nextVersion: Saving a changed body snapshots it as v{version}
config.dangerBody: Removes it from every agent. This can't be undone.

preview.title: Preview
preview.subtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.
preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from a file someone else wrote. Its body goes into your agent's prompt verbatim — read it before you enable it.
preview.empty: This skill has no body yet.

create.title: Create skill
create.subtitle: A skill is a block of reviewer instructions. The body is the only text the model sees.

import.title: Import a skill
import.subtitle: Markdown (.md) or an archive (.zip). We read the skill's markdown and nothing else.
import.previewNote: Nothing is saved yet. Review the body below, then confirm.
import.ignoredNote: Executable and non-markdown entries are listed, never opened and never run.
import.disabledNote: An imported skill is saved disabled. Read it, then enable it when you trust it.
import.savedToast: Imported "{name}" — saved disabled until you enable it.

versions.title: Version history
versions.hint: Every body change is snapshotted, so a run that cited an older version can still be explained. Restoring writes the old text forward as a new version — it never rewinds the history.
versions.currentNote: The body in the editor right now
versions.diffTitle: v{version} compared with the current body
versions.noChanges: This snapshot is identical to the current body.
versions.restoreConfirm: Restore v{version}? Its text becomes the current body and is saved as a new version.
versions.loadError: Could not load the version history.

stats.title: Usage
stats.hint: Agent links are current; every run-derived number covers the last {days} days.
stats.attributionNote: A run carries several skills at once, so these are findings from runs whose prompt included this skill — not findings it caused. There is no per-skill attribution in the data.

empty.title: No usage yet
empty.body: This skill is not attached to any agent and no run has carried it. Add it to an agent to start collecting usage.
